Remark
[Entropy condition under uniform convexity] ↗ def:shock-entropy-condition 1. ch3:3.4.1-rem-2\group Conservation Laws

If $F''\ge \theta >0$, then $F'$ is strictly increasing and the entropy inequalities are equivalent to $u_l>u_r$.
